name: Venison & Red Wine Stew
description: A rich, dark winter stew with juniper and thyme. This file has no recipeCategory: the meal comes from a meal: keyword.
keywords: meal:Main, protein:Other, carb:None / Other, winter, slow cook

recipeInstructions.text: Toss the venison in the seasoned flour and brown in batches in 2 tbsp of the oil in a large casserole. Set aside.
Fry the lardons in the remaining oil until golden, then add the onions and carrots and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, juniper and thyme, then return the venison and pour in the wine and stock.
Cover and simmer very gently for 2 hours until the meat is tender. Stir in the redcurrant jelly and season to taste.
